summary: Backend + frontend validation of the new address-search / geocoding feature. Backend: 38/39 pytest cases pass; the single failure is the pre-existing SB-001 vs SB-2001 seed mismatch (explicitly ignored per review). Added TestGeocode class with 4 cases covering: (a) GET /api/geocode requires auth -> 401 without token; (b) empty q -> 200 []; (c) nonsense q -> 200 [] (no 5xx, no exception leak); (d) '1600 Pennsylvania Ave Washington DC' -> 200 with >=1 result whose display_name contains 'White House' / 'Pennsylvania' and coords ~ (38.8976, -77.0366). All prior tests (auth, equipment CRUD, bracing, rentals CRUD + edit + partial return + capacity, rental location PATCH, bookings/capacity, maintenance, vendors, site, dashboard w/o upcoming_returns) still pass. Frontend (mobile 390x844): logged in as admin, navigated More -> Rentals, tapped '+' to open New Rental. The 'Job site location' card contains the new 'Search address' Input (testID `address-search-input`) and 'Search address' Button (testID `address-search-btn`); typing '1600 Pennsylvania Ave Washington DC' and tapping Search shows a results block (testID `address-results`) with 1 tappable row (testID `address-result-0`) showing 'White House, 1600, Pennsylvania Avenue Northwest, Ward 2, Washington, District of Columbia, 20500, United States' and formatted coords '38.8976, -77.0366'. Tapping the row: (1) closes the results list, (2) writes coord badge '38.89764, -77.03655' into the card, (3) prefills the previously-empty Job Site input with the display_name. Legacy 'Pick on map' (draft-pick-map) and 'Geocode job site' (draft-geocode) buttons are still present and unchanged. Only known console warning remains the carried-over expo-notifications web-push listener message (non-blocking).

minor.issue: Pre-existing SB-001 vs SB-2001 seed-SKU mismatch; unrelated to this iteration and explicitly ignored per review request.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Carried over from prior iterations.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align TestEquipment.test_list_seeded with current seed SKUs (SB-2001 etc.) OR restore original SB-001 sample in server.py seed(). Pre-existing; safe to defer.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:874-909 — GeocodeResult model + GET /api/geocode. Endpoint is guarded by get_current_user (401 for missing/invalid bearer). Uses a single lazy httpx.AsyncClient (`_geo_client`) with base_url=nominatim.openstreetmap.org and a proper User-Agent (Nominatim policy). Robust error handling: empty query short-circuits []; non-200 responses log a warning and return []; any exception from httpx also returns []. Malformed candidate entries are skipped via inner try/except. limit=5 correctly caps candidates. Client is closed in on_shutdown alongside push client.

Nominatim usage note: tests deliberately sleep ~1.1s before hitting the real address query to respect ~1 rps rate limit. From this cloud egress the query returned real results (White House match), so the pass path is exercised.

rentals.tsx:370 renders <Input testID='address-search-input' /> and rentals.tsx:377 the 'Search address' button. Results wrap has testID `address-results` and each row `address-result-<idx>`. Behavior verified: pick sets draft.lat/lng, closes list, and prefills draft.job_site only when previously empty (verified UI-side with cleared cust-site). Coord badge in the location card renders '38.89764, -77.03655' after the pick.
Coord formatting on the card uses ~5 decimals (38.89764, -77.03655) while the result-row shows 4 decimals (38.8976, -77.0366). Cosmetic inconsistency; not a bug.

Legacy flows unchanged: draft-geocode + draft-pick-map still present. Save button still branches on draft.id for PUT vs POST; the new geocode endpoint does not interact with rental persistence, so create/edit + PATCH /location regressions are unaffected (all rental tests still green).
